page.overview:
Who is Stefan Gremsky?

Stefan Gremsky is a character in Cars 2.

In Cars 2, He first appeared on the oil rig where Finn McMissile discovered his colleague Leland Turbo was killed. He with the other Lemons traps Finn on the rock of the platform and tries to kill him with a blowtorch, but Finn gives up and falls into the ocean and turns into a speedboat.
